title: hepetis arcuata
intro: Hepetis arcuata, commonly known as Wedelia or Sphagneticola trilobata, is a tropical plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Hepetis arcuata include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a useful remedy for various health conditions.
